Choose MAT_BeamReissnerElastHyper, MAT_BeamReissnerElastHyper_ByModes or MAT_BeamReissnerElastPlastic!" — it names the offending material and enumerates the three legal ones. Neither 'requires beam material' nor 4C_mat_beam_base.cpp exists in 4C. The abort is at element-read time (SOLIDMAT_FIELDS_BUILT=0). Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
